description: Reopen r-sort-3b-nulls (General) read-only. On NI1, NI2, NI5 and NR1 reads the IDs of WHERE K IS NULL, WHERE K IS NOT NULL, WHERE K = empty, WHERE K >= empty, ORDER BY K then ID, ORDER BY K DESC then ID, and (COUNT(*), COUNT(K)); on NI3, NI4 and NR3 the IDs of ORDER BY K, N, ID, WHERE K IS NULL AND N IS NULL and WHERE N IS NULL ORDER BY ID. Asks whether SQL sees the same rows and Null placement through an IGNORE NULL index as through a plain one.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
